s.t:
Bravos Research is a leading video-first investment research and financial media company. We help investors navigate global markets with data-driven market research and video content.
We’ve built the largest investment research channel on YouTube, with over 80M views and thousands of clients subscribed to our paid research.
We're looking for an Account Executive to be the first point of contact for investors discovering Bravos Research . Every day, serious investors find us through our YouTube channel and want to learn more about our research services. Your role is to talk with them, understand what they're trying to achieve in the markets, and help them decide whether our research and strategy is the right fit for them

Speak with investors who have engaged with our YouTube channel and want to learn more about our research.
Understand each investor's experience, goals, and approach to the markets, then guide them toward the service that fits.
Represent the Bravos Research brand with professionalism.
Maintain detailed records and follow up with investors who need more time to decide.
1-2 years of experience in transactional sales

10% uncapped commission
OTE $120,000 to $200,000+
Fully remote

To apply, submit your resume and a cover letter that tells us about yourself, what you can bring to Bravos Research , and how this role fits in your future.
Tell us about something you’ve done, something that’s relevant to the work we do, or something you're passionate about.
We want to hear your unique voice of why you want to work with us and see some creativity and effort. Generic or AI-generated cover letters will be disregarded.
We look forward to hearing from you!

You will be at the forefront of transforming how the world’s most influential manufacturers manage their spare parts. Your mission is to win, grow, and partner with customers who keep global industries running. You will dive deep into how factories operate, uncover where inefficiencies drain millions, and show how SPARETECH turns chaotic spare parts data into real financial and operational impact.
You will help customers avoid downtime, unlock working capital, and move closer to a zero waste industrial sharing economy by selling a platform that is reshaping the future of manufacturing.

s.h: We offer you the opportunity to
s.t:
Own the revenue journey: Win enterprise deals, expand accounts, and build trusted partnerships with global brands in automotive, electronics, pharma, and food and beverage.
Drive meaningful impact: Help customers solve real operational problems by bringing clarity, transparency, and efficiency to their spare parts processes.
Build the playbooks of the future: Develop scalable sales motions, cross sell strategies, and growth frameworks as we evolve our go to market engine.
Represent SPARETECH : Lead customer meetings, run on site sessions, and stand for SPARETECH at industry events and regional meetups.
Shape what we build: Bring customer insights directly into Product and Leadership to influence roadmap decisions that define the next stage of our platform.
Grow fast: Learn how to sell complex SaaS into mission critical industrial environments and see your work influence revenue, product direction, and our scale story.
Take real ownership: Step into a role where your ideas matter, your execution is visible, and your success accelerates your path.
Become a part of our team if you
Bring experience: Have 4 to 7 years of B2B SaaS or Enterprise Sales experience with a record of closing new logos and expanding existing customers.
Know the Shop Floor: Have been on site in factories or production environments and can discuss real operational workflows and constraints.
Navigate all stakeholders: Speak comfortably with engineers, procurement teams, and executives, adapting your message to each.
Understand the Industry: Bring knowledge in one or more of manufacturing, electronics, pharma, chemicals, or food and beverage.
Speak Fluently: Are proficient in German and English.
Travel when it matters: Travel to customers 1 to 2 days per week to build strong, lasting relationships.
Show Curiosity and Drive: A technical or business degree is a plus, but your learning mindset and ownership attitude matter more.
You can expect
A remote-yes company, where you can decide every day whether you work from home, at our Stuttgart or Munich office, or at any Design Office in Germany.
A permanent employment contract, 30 days of vacation, and the opportunity to participate in the company's success through our VSOP program.
Modern hardware and the frame for a height-adjustable desk.
An annual training budget of 1000,00 EURO for your professional development.
In Germany: A subsidized job bike to escape city traffic and a Wellpass gym membership to stay active.
A dynamic start-up atmosphere and an international team in which new ideas, creative approaches, and cooperation at eye level are valued.
To enjoy Corporate Benefits, including discounts on fashion, travel, and much more from various companies.
About SPARETECH
SPARETECH 's vision is to empower the zero-waste industrial sharing economy by enabling maintenance and procurement teams at manufacturing leaders like Bosch, Porsche, and Nestlé to reduce MRO spend and optimize inventory through accurate part information, internal transparency, and market visibility.
To achieve this, we have built, and continue to build, an AI-powered MRO software that connects all players in the spare parts ecosystem, from manufacturers and suppliers to the people working behind the machines. By facilitating the exchange of data, knowledge, and expertise, we create shared visibility that empowers smarter decisions, reduces waste, and drives seamless collaboration. This connected spare parts intelligence unlocks value that extends far beyond software.
Backed by Insight Partners, SPARETECH is accelerating its growth with a strong focus on product innovation and team excellence. We take pride in our inclusive and collaborative culture, as well as our energetic and committed team.

Location Our Channel Account Manager will be an integral part of our Sales team in EMEA. This role is based remotely in the UK, Ireland, Estonia, the Netherlands and Sweden. Who We Are DoiT is a global technology company that works with cloud-driven organizations to leverage the cloud to drive business growth and innovation.

We combine data, technology, and human expertise to ensure our customers operate in a well-architected and scalable state - from planning to production. Delivering DoiT Cloud Intelligence, the only solution that integrates advanced technology with human intelligence, we help our customers solve complex multi-cloud problems and drive efficiency.

With decades of multi-cloud experience, we have specializations in Kubernetes, GenAI, CloudOps, and more. An award-winning strategic partner of AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure, we work alongside more than 4,000 customers worldwide.

The Opportunity The core mission of the Channel Account Manager is to cultivate and expand relationships with our key channel partners which include Distributors, Managed Services Providers, and Resellers. This role combines strategic relationship management and enablement responsibilities with outbound energy and partner development hustle.

You will serve as the primary point of contact for channel partners while simultaneously helping them identify and drive new opportunities for DoiT’s PartnerOps solutions, DoiT Cloud Intelligence, PerfectScale, Select, and Attribute — building the pipeline and partnerships that fuel DoiT's indirect channel growth.

Responsibilities Channel Partner Relationship Management
Serve as the dedicated relationship owner for channel partners, acting as their primary point of contact across commercial, technical, and operational matters.
Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships with key stakeholders at channel partners — including partner principals, channel managers, sales teams, and technical leads.
Conduct regular business reviews with channel partners to assess performance, align on pipeline, and identify growth opportunities.
Represent DoiT at partner events, industry conferences, and partner-hosted summits to strengthen brand presence and deepen relationships.
Pitch, Discovery & Pipeline Development
Lead compelling, confident introductory pitches of DoiT’s solutions to channel partner sales teams and their customers without requiring technical support in room.
Work with the channel partners on executing customer deal registration for DoiT’s solutions.
Work alongside the Channel Account Executive to track all customer deal registrations from the channel partner to move these opportunities from qualification through close.
Channel Strategy & Joint GTM
Develop and execute joint business plans with channel partners, setting clear revenue targets, milestones, and co-sell activities.
Influence channel partner roadmaps and go-to-market strategies to increase DoiT's share of wallet within their customer base.
Collaborate with DoiT's Marketing team on channel-specific campaigns, events and initiatives.
Monitor and report on channel market trends, competitive dynamics, and partner ecosystem developments to inform DoiT's channel strategy.
Partner Enablement
Work alongside DoiT’s Partner Success Team to design and deliver enablement programs equipping channel partner sales and technical teams to effectively position and sell DoiT solutions.
Support channel partners with the tools, materials, and knowledge they need to confidently position DoiT products in end-customer conversations.
Partner with Product and Marketing to develop channel-ready collateral, playbooks, and co-branded materials tailored to channel audiences.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Act as an advocate internally for channel partners — communicating partner needs, deal context, and escalation requests across the organization.
Provide structured feedback to leadership, Product, and GTM Strategy teams on partner performance, competitive intelligence, and market signals from the field.
Ensure clean deal registration, CRM accuracy, and pipeline hygiene across all partner-sourced opportunities.

7+ years of experience in channel sales, partner management, or indirect channel roles.
Proven ability to operate across both strategic partner management and outbound partner development within the same role or program.
Deep understanding of Reseller and MSP business models, channel economics, and the technology distribution landscape.
Strong knowledge of cloud channel programs and partner ecosystems across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
Proven ability to lead an initial product pitch and structured discovery conversation independently, without requiring technical support.
Experience working within FinOps, CloudOps, or cloud cost management domains is a significant advantage; curiosity and willingness to develop deep product knowledge is essential.
Excellent prospecting, relationship-building, communication, and executive presentation skills — equally comfortable opening cold conversations and running senior partner QBRs.
Highly organized with strong CRM discipline and the ability to manage a high volume of partner relationships and active pipeline simultaneously.
Self-motivated, entrepreneurial, and energized by building in a fast-moving, remote-first environment.

Als Account Manager Performance Marketing (m/w/d) bei SPCTR. übernimmst du Verantwortung für eigene Kundenaccounts und wirst zu dem festen Ansprechpartner, dem unsere Kunden vertrauen. Wir arbeiten als verlängerte Online-Marketing-Abteilung, von wachsenden Start-ups bis zu namhaften größeren Unternehmen.
Deine Rolle sitzt genau an der Schnittstelle: Du führst deine Kunden souverän durch Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews und arbeitest gleichzeitig operativ in den Accounts, wenn Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat umgesetzt und optimiert werden. SEO und GEO gewinnen dabei zunehmend an Bedeutung, genauso wie der Einsatz von KI und Automatisierung im Alltag. Bei uns arbeitet das ganze Team mit Claude.
Was wir am meisten schätzen, lässt sich schwer in eine Anforderungsliste fassen: Proaktivität. Menschen, die Probleme früh benennen und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag um die Ecke kommen. Wenn du dich darin wiedererkennst und unternehmerisch denkst, passt du zu uns.
Aufgaben
Du betreust eigene Kundenaccounts eigenverantwortlich und bist der feste Ansprechpartner für Strategie, Umsetzung und Ergebnisse.
Du führst Jour Fixes und Quarterly Business Reviews selbstständig, auch bei größeren Kunden mit mehreren Entscheidern und festen Entscheidungswegen.
Du setzt Performance-Kampagnen auf Google, Meta, TikTok und Snapchat operativ um und optimierst sie kontinuierlich entlang klarer KPIs.
Du denkst die Accounts ganzheitlich und bringst SEO- und GEO-Themen mit ins Spiel, wenn sie zu den Zielen des Kunden passen.
Du erstellst Analysen, Reportings und Dashboards und leitest daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen für Kunden und Team ab.
Du nutzt KI-Tools und Automatisierungen aktiv im Tagesgeschäft, bei uns vor allem Claude, für Analysen, Reportings, Recherchen und operative Prozesse.
Du erkennst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und manuelle Workflows und denkst sie proaktiv in Richtung Automatisierung weiter.
Du benennst Probleme früh, transparent und mit einem Lösungsvorschlag im Gepäck.
Du behältst Markt, neue Plattform-Features sowie Entwicklungen rund um KI, Search und GEO im Blick und bringst Relevantes ins Team ein.
Du arbeitest eng mit Kolleginnen und Kollegen aus Performance, Content und Design zusammen, in flachen Hierarchien mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
Qualifikation
Du bringst 1 bis 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Online oder Performance Marketing mit, idealerweise im Agenturumfeld oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle mit direktem Kundenkontakt.
Du hast ein Studium im Bereich BWL, Marketing, Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares abgeschlossen, eine passende Ausbildung gemacht oder dir dein Können in der Praxis erarbeitet.
Du bist kommunikationsstark und trittst gegenüber Kunden klar, souverän und professionell auf, auch wenn mehrere Entscheider und festgelegte Prozesse im Spiel sind.
Du kennst dich praktisch mit Google Ads und Meta Ads aus. Erfahrung mit Looker Studio, Google Analytics und Google Tag Manager ist ein Plus.
Du hast idealerweise ein Grundverständnis von SEO und GEO, gerne auch mehr, und richtig Lust, dich in diese Themen weiter einzuarbeiten.
Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit KI-Tools wie zum Beispiel Claude oder ChatGPT und siehst darin einen echten Hebel für produktiveres Arbeiten.
Du hast Drive: Du willst dich und das Unternehmen aktiv nach vorne entwickeln und übernimmst Verantwortung, ohne dass man dich darum bitten muss.
Du arbeitest strukturiert, verlässlich und priorisiert, und verlierst auch bei mehreren Projekten parallel nicht den Überblick.
Du kommst mit modernen Tools gut zurecht. Wir arbeiten mit awork sowie Microsoft 365 und Teams.
Du bist Teamplayer, schaust über den eigenen Tellerrand und unterstützt dein Kollegium, wenn es eng wird.

Ein offenes und engagiertes Team, das von den Gründern selbst geführt wird und einen starken Zusammenhalt pflegt. Auch nach der Arbeit.
Echte Account-Verantwortung von Anfang an, mit Kunden, bei denen du deine Wirkung siehst.
Ein Umfeld, in dem KI und Automatisierung ausdrücklich gewünscht sind und neue Tools und Ideen ausprobiert statt ausgebremst werden.
GEO und KI-Sichtbarkeit als Zukunftsthema, das du mit uns gemeinsam aufbaust.
Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und flache Hierarchien.
Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, vollständig remote zu arbeiten.
Work from anywhere: Arbeite von dort, wo du am besten arbeiten kannst, plus die Möglichkeit, in unserem Büro in Köln zu arbeiten (optional auch Hamburg).
Spannende Start-ups und namhafte größere Kunden, an denen du fachlich schnell wächst.
Datengetriebenes Arbeiten, ehrliche Kommunikation und moderne Marketingprozesse.
Klingt das nach der richtigen Herausforderung für dich? Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.
Eigenschaften wie Drive und Lernfähigkeit zeigen sich selten im Kennenlerncall, sondern erst in der Zusammenarbeit. Deshalb halten wir den Prozess schlank und ehrlich: Wenn es von beiden Seiten passt, merken wir das schnell.
Wenn du Kunden souverän führen willst, Performance Marketing operativ stark umsetzt und Lust hast, SEO, GEO und KI-gestützte Arbeitsweisen mit uns weiterzudenken, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Bewirb dich jetzt und werde Teil des Teams bei SPCTR.

s.h: These are our current challenges and future goals

s.h: This is where we need your support

Market Entry & Expansion — You build our business in Italy, with a focus on drugstores, pharmacies/parapharmacies, online retail and selected grocery partners.
Account Management — You manage existing customers and win new partners through compelling pitches and tailored product range proposals.
Promotions & Trade Marketing — You plan and coordinate promotions, point-of-sale materials and sampling campaigns together with the marketing team.
Cross-functional Collaboration — You work closely with internal teams across marketing, operations, regulatory and e-commerce.
Market & Competitive Analysis — You keep an eye on trends, spot opportunities and develop new distribution ideas for the Italian market.
Representation — You represent Glow25 at trade shows, customer meetings and industry events across Italy.

Several years of experience in key account management, ideally in FMCG, beauty or health
A strong understanding of the Italian retail landscape — drugstores, pharmacies/parapharmacies, online retail and grocery
Fluent Italian and English
Spanish is a nice to have (bonus if you can also work in/with Spanish-speaking partners or markets)
A structured, proactive way of working with a real hands-on attitude
Confident use of everyday tools: Google Workspace, Slack, Asana and a CRM system as well as AI
Experience with pharmacy / parapharmacy channels — especially knowledge of the specific mechanics, decision processes and trade marketing setup in that environment is a bonus

s.h: That's something you can look forward to
s.t:
Work flexibly, in the way that suits you best. Work when and where you’re most productive – with flexible hours and smart time tracking.
Home office? Done right. We’ve got you covered: receive a one-time €500 allowance to set up your perfect workspace.
Fully equipped from day one. Mac or Windows – you choose what works best for you.
Glow Card – your monthly treat. Get €50 every month to spend however you like – that’s €600 a year, just because.
Learning is part of the deal. Whether it’s our Glowcademy, dedicated learning time, or personal development support – we invest in you, not just in numbers.
Let’s Glow! Enjoy 40% off our entire product range – yes, everything.
Take a break – you’ve earned it. 30 vacation days + 1 personal holiday + up to 10 additional unpaid days off when you need a real reset. Oh, and New Year’s Eve? That’s a day off too!
Stay healthy, stay glowing. Our company health insurance reimburses up to €600 per year for extras like vision aids, alternative medicine, or dental cleanings.
Thinking ahead. After your probation period, we’ll contribute €600 toward your pension plan – and if you add more, we’ll top it up with an extra 20%.
Exclusive partner perks. Get access to discounts and special offers from top brands through our corporate benefit platforms.
Culture that truly shines. For five years in a row, we’ve been recognized as a Top Company on Kununu - proof of the strong, positive, and genuine culture we live every day.
Move your way. From workouts to wellness retreats – you decide how to stay active. Choose between Urban Sports Club or Wellpass.
Yay! You've made it this far!
But there’s one more thing we want to say: Don’t hesitate! Especially if you’re a woman, or from an underrepresented group. Even if you don’t check every box, we want to encourage you to apply anyway. We believe that a diverse range of perspectives and experiences makes a team stronger – and the stronger our team is, the better we can fulfil our mission of helping people bring more energy into their daily lives.

We are hiring an Account Executive to support the client operating rhythm around Storm Ideas ' Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design work.
You will work alongside senior account colleagues on accounts that are often messy, fast-moving, and operationally complex. Your job is to keep the detail straight: who the stakeholders are, what was decided, what is still open, who owns the next step, and what is at risk of slipping.
The role exists because this kind of client work fails when account knowledge lives in scattered notes, private conversations, or one person's head. You will be the person who makes sure that does not happen.
You will not own the commercial relationship or set client strategy on day one — that sits with the Account Manager. But you will be close to clients, in the meetings, on the follow-up, and trusted to write things clients read. This is a role with a clear path into full account ownership for someone who moves fast.
AI is not an optional productivity trick here. You should already be using AI in real work and be hungry to get much better at it — prep, research, summarisation, action tracking, drafting, and reusable account memory.

What can you expect?
Maintain account context for selected Creative Operations and Systems / Process Design clients: stakeholders, priorities, history, open questions, decisions, and follow-ups.
Keep the operating rhythm running — meeting prep, notes, actions, blockers, and handoffs that do not depend on anyone's memory.
Turn client conversations into clear next steps, owners, and open questions, and flag early when something is vague or at risk.
Draft clear, client-ready summaries and updates that make messy work understandable without overpromising.
Build and maintain stakeholder maps, decision logs, and follow-up trackers that others can actually use.
Get genuinely good at AI-enabled account management: prep packs, account research, summarisation, QA checks, and repeatable workflows.
Work closely with Account Management, Creative Operations, AI Operations, and technical colleagues to keep client work moving.
Understand creative and operational workflows well enough to ask practical questions and explain things in plain English.
Your Expertise
Some experience in a client-facing, account support, coordination, or operational role — agency, media, or tech.
Strong written and spoken English. You can make a messy situation feel clear, calm, and practical.
High agency. You do not wait for every next step to be handed to you, and you escalate early when you should.
Structured thinking. You can break ambiguous work into inputs, outputs, owners, statuses, and next steps.
Real interest in AI-enabled account management. You are already using AI in your work and want to get much better at it.
Good client presence. Warm, curious, responsive, and reliable on follow-up.
Comfortable around tools such as Airtable, , Notion, Asana, spreadsheets, Slack, or Teams.

What Success Looks Like
Nothing gets lost. Actions, decisions, and open questions are captured and easy for others to pick up.
Client meetings are better prepared because context, risks, and likely asks were organised in advance.
Clients find you responsive, clear, and easy to work with.
Vague asks become useful follow-up questions or clear internal next steps.
Account knowledge lives in shared systems, not one person's head.
AI becomes part of how you prepare, document, and summarise — not just how you polish writing.
This Role Will Suit You If
You like being close to clients and close to how work actually gets done.
You enjoy turning messy requests into clear, practical steps.
You combine warmth with structure.
You want to use AI to run account management better than a normal notes-and-memory process can.
You are comfortable working when the answer is not written down yet, as long as you can find the next sensible step.
You want to grow into full account ownership.
This Role Will Not Suit You If
You want to be a message-passer between the client and the delivery team.
You need every workflow, owner, and decision path perfectly defined before you can move.
You are uncomfortable asking clients precise follow-up questions.
You only see AI as a way to polish writing rather than improve how account management works.
You think client relationship management is mainly being polite.
Working Environment
Remote-first team with international colleagues and globally recognised entertainment clients.
Modern hardware, collaboration tools, AI-enabled workflows, and room to improve how work happens.
Fast-moving culture where thoughtful ideas from people close to the work are valued.

Deine Aufgaben: Kundenführung: Du betreust eigenverantwortlich A-Potential-Accounts (sowie ausgewählte B-Accounts), steuerst deren Priorisierung, Ziel- und Maßnahmenplanung und erkennst ungenutzte Potenziale, um daraus neue Projekte anzustoßen und die Pipeline gezielt auszubauen. Bereits in der Pitch- und Angebotsphase gestaltest du Scope und Leistungsversprechen aktiv mit.
Beratung & Workshops: Du verantwortest Formate wie jährliche Kunden-Workshops und Reviews und berätst auf Basis der Zielsetzung, Budgets und internen Dynamiken deiner Kunden passgenau.
Schnittstelle & Enablement: Du bildest die Brücke zwischen Kunden, Geschäftsführung und Fachteams (z. B. UX, Creative, Digital Marketing) und hilfst Projektmanager:innen, Kundensignale richtig zu deuten und in die operative Arbeit zu übersetzen.
Risiko- & Eskalationsmanagement: Du erkennst kritische Kundensignale frühzeitig, klärst Eskalationen auf Entscheiderebene souverän und hältst den Projektteams den Rücken frei.
Enger Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung: Du berichtest regelmäßig zu Status, NRR, Kundenqualität und relevanten KPIs und treibst im engen Austausch die Weiterentwicklung unseres Account-Management-Systems voran.
Du bringst mit: Fundierte Erfahrung im Senior / Lead Account Management: Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der strategischen Betreuung und Skalierung von B2B-Bestandskunden im Agentur- oder digitalen Beratungsumfeld.
Exzellentes Stakeholder-Management: Du baust ab Tag 1 Glaubwürdigkeit auf C-Level und Sponsorenebene auf und bewegst dich sicher auch in komplexen, konfliktbehafteten Kundensituationen.
Souveräne Moderation & Beratung: Erfahrung in Konzeption und Durchführung von Strategie-Workshops sowie in der zielgerichteten Moderation von Kundenterminen.
Ausgeprägtes Business- & Finanzverständnis: Kennzahlen wie NRR, Margen, Pipeline-Ökonomie und Kundenrentabilität sind für dich vertrautes Handwerkszeug.
Analytisches Gespür & Proaktivität: Du erkennst aus scheinbar kleinen Signalen – etwa veränderten Budgetfreigaben, neuen Ansprechpartnern oder verzögerten Rückmeldungen – frühzeitig Chancen oder Risiken und leitest konkrete nächste Schritte daraus ab.
Führung durch Überzeugung: Du überzeugst interdisziplinäre Teams inhaltlich für gemeinsame Ziele, auch ohne disziplinarische Weisungsbefugnis.
Deine Benefits: Team & Atmosphäre: Familiäres, teamorientiertes Umfeld mit motivierten Kolleg:innen – hier entstehen Freundschaften.
Gute Kommunikation : Offene Feedbackkultur und kurze, unbürokratische Wege.
Spannende Aufgaben: Abwechslungsreiche Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum.
Flexibilität: Home Office und flexible Arbeitszeiten für eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance.
Transparente Zeitregelung: Jede Überstunde zählt – ab der ersten Minute.
Teamevents: Von Dönerstag bis Kinderfasching - wir lieben unsere regelmäßigen gemeinsamen Aktivitäten.
Gesundheit & Umwelt: JobRad-Angebot für nachhaltige Mobilität.

At Conga, we’ve built a community where our colleagues can thrive. Here you’ll find opportunities to innovate and support growth through individual and team development, all within an environment where every voice is heard.
Conga lines up commercial operations so companies run as connected, smarter businesses. By unifying the people and processes that drive commerce, Conga aligns pricing, quoting, contracting, rebates, and communications so teams stay in sync and buyers keep moving forward.

The result is trusted decisions, consistent buyer experiences, and profitable growth. More than 10,000 customers worldwide, including over 50% of the Fortune 100®, trust Conga when commercial complexity is high and global impact is on the line.

A Quick Snapshot…..
As an Account Executive, you'll be at the forefront of our revenue growth strategy, spearheading efforts to uncover and nurture new business prospects while strengthening connections with our current clientele.

Your role will involve deeply understanding client requirements, crafting personalized solutions, and ensuring top-notch customer satisfaction.

Collaborating closely with Sales Engineering, Business/Sales Development, Marketing, Transformation Specialists, Customer Success, Professional Services, Partners and clients, your primary focus will be on prospecting, managing and closing new business opportunities for enterprise-wide CONGA solutions with organizations across a variety of key strategic industries/verticals in the B2B space.
Why it’s big deal…
You'll have the chance to sell high-impact, mission-critical projects with substantial value, driving transformational change for our clients in Central Europe. Your role will involve skillfully crafting and implementing territory, account, and opportunity plans to optimize revenue within your assigned selling patch. You'll expertly manage sales opportunities throughout every stage of the cycle, ensuring success for both our clients and our company.

s.h: Are you the person we are looking for?
s.t:
Proven track record.   You have at least 5 years successful B2B technology Enterprise sales experience in the SaaS industry, in Central Europe.
Proficiency in revenue management principles is crucial.
You have a consistent track record of over achieving quota and revenue targets.
You cultivate and leverage strategic relationships with partners to drive mutual business growth and success.
Knowledge and experience in general AI and machine learning can bring significant value. You understand how AI can enhance revenue management processes.
Hunter mentality. You'll have the opportunity to unleash your inner hunter and drive our growth through relentless pursuit of new business opportunities. You thrive in a fast-paced environment, leveraging your strategic mindset and tenacity to identify, pursue, and close deals with potential clients. The focus is 90% new business.
Solution Selling.  Collaborate with prospects and clients to understand their unique challenges and business goals. Present Conga's comprehensive suite of solutions and services that align with clients' needs, demonstrating a deep understanding of how Conga can provide value.
Drive . You have the ability to successfully leverage resources and take initiative. The most successful Conga reps are the ones who stop at nothing to achieve success no matter the circumstance.
Communication : You have the ability to articulate complex technology concepts to a technical and non-technical audience. You also have superb listening skills and you understand objections and overcome them by turning skeptics into enthusiastic new customers and brand ambassadors. You possess Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Growth Mindset . As the business landscape is constantly evolving you adapt to changes in market conditions, customer preferences, and competitive dynamics. You innovate and develop creative solutions to address challenges and capitalize on opportunities in the revenue management space.
Collaboration.   You'll work closely with cross-functional teams including Sales Engineering, Business Development, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver exceptional value to our clients and drive mutual success. Together, we'll leverage each other's expertise and insights to achieve our goals and surpass expectations. You have the gravitas to lead a winning team, leveraging the strengths and skills of the organization to deliver profitable business to the organization.
What will give you an edge...
Experience selling Revenue Lifecycle Management solutions with a good understanding of CPQ, revenue optimization, CLM, doc-gen and e-signature products.
Education and/or experience in Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, Accounting, Marketing, Finance, or Operations Research considered a plus.
